rationale: Chinguun is a full-stack developer with Python and TypeScript expertise at Starch, while Aditya is an embedded systems engineer deploying AI models on resource-constrained microcontrollers using Python, C++, and TensorFlow Lite. Aditya's work in edge AI and intelligent control for robotics and prosthetics could benefit from Chinguun's full-stack development experience, and Chinguun may find Aditya's embedded AI and edge computing challenges an interesting technical domain to explore.
intro_message: Chinguun Ganbaatar, meet Aditya bangde — a roboticist focused on deploying AI and RL on edge devices who could use your full-stack Python/TypeScript skills, and vice versa on embedded systems challenges.
